AvailableFields.description: Field and variable catalogue of one domain.

fields.description: Item fields a column may show, keyed by field: label, type (`text`, `currency`, `image`, ...), group, example; `[]` for a domain without any

variables.description: Variables per group (`model`, ...): key -> label; `[]` for a domain without any

CalculateRequest.description: Lines to price. Unknown keys are ignored.

currency_id.description: Currency to price in; the workspace default when left out.

Conditions.description: When a template or profile is picked.

CreateCurrencyRequest.description: New currency. `asset_type` is an ISO 4217 code.

CreateDealRequest.description: New deal. Without `currency_id` the workspace default currency is used.

CreatePaymentRequest.description: A payment on an invoice: money (`payment_method`) or a credit note (`settle_invoice_id`).

amount.description: Decimal amount in currency units, greater than 0, within the currency's decimals.

settle_invoice_id.description: Pending credit note of the same relation to settle with.

CreateStatusRequest.description: New column. `deal_pipeline_id` is required but the path picks the board.

workspace_name.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.

CreateWorkspaceRequest.description: Sign up: a new account plus its first workspace.

CreditInvoiceRequest.description: Credit the whole invoice (`credit_all`) or the listed lines.

items.description: Required unless `credit_all` is true; up to 1000 lines.

CurrencyCreated.description: Create response: the new row's id.

CurrencyResource.description: A currency the workspace can price in. Exactly one is the default.

DealResource.description: A deal. Board columns (and lists) leave out `deal_pipeline`, `deal_pipeline_status` and `custom_sections` under `relationships`.

EmailTemplateBody.description: An email template. Create needs every field but `conditions` and `meta`; update needs only `body`, ignores `template_domain` and keeps what is left out.

oneOf.description: When this template is picked; null clears them.

template_domain.description: What the template is for (`invoice`, `estimate`, ...); create only.

oneOf.description: Null when the uploader left the workspace.

FileResource.description: A stored file. `file_path` is a signed download URL valid for a few minutes.

file_path.description: A signed URL valid for a few minutes.

client_secret.description: Send the mask back to use the stored secret.

oneOf.description: Team the invitee joins on accepting.

InviteResource.description:
One settings pending-invites row (Laravel InviteResource). `invite_code` is left out: only
its hash is stored, and the link goes to the invitee alone.
A sent invite, as listed in workspace settings.

invited_by.description: Email of whoever sent the invite.

InviteStatusResponse.description:
GET /v1/invites/get-invite-status/{code} body (Laravel InviteStatusResource keys).
What an invite link points to, for the accept or sign-up screen.

new_user.description: No account uses this email yet: show the sign-up form.

InvoiceBalance.description: Paid, open and total amounts of an invoice.

open.description: Total minus paid (negative when overpaid); JSON number.

paid.description: 0 (integer) when nothing is paid, else the paid sum as decimal text with 8 places

InvoiceBody.description: Invoice header plus item lines. Create ignores `due_date` and `customer_ref`; update ignores `currency_id`, `payment_method` and `is_credit`, keeps fields left out, and changes only the lines sent (a line with `id` updates it, `deleted: true` removes it, no `id` adds one).

billing_address.description: Address object; create takes the relation's when left out.

currency_id.description: Create only; the workspace default when left out.

invoice_nr.description: Formatted number; null until sent, `N/A` when cancelled.

InvoiceItem.description: One invoice line. Amounts are decimal text.

available_stock.description: The product's available stock (0 without a product).

product.description: Product fields the line shows (`id`, `name`, `product_nr`, prices, stock); only on product lines.

InvoiceLinks.description: Invoice `relationships`; the always-null and always-empty ones are kept for old clients.

oneOf.description: The sent PDF; null until sent or when the file is gone.

InvoiceListBalance.description: Paid and open amounts of an invoice in a list.

paid.description: 0 (integer) when nothing is paid, else the paid sum as decimal text with 8 places

InvoiceListPage.description: `GET /invoices`: a page with `meta`, or with `limit` up to that many rows and no `meta`.

date.description: The payment day at midnight UTC.

invoice_nr.description: Formatted number; null until sent, `N/A` when cancelled.

payment_hash.description: Token of the public payment page; null until sent.

ItemLine.description: One item line. Numbers may also be sent as decimal strings; unknown keys are ignored.

deleted.description: Stored documents only: true drops the line.

multi_set_item_id.description: Set when the line is part of a multi-set product; echoed back.

mutate_from_warehouse_id.description: Stored documents only: warehouse to take stock from.

LaneProps.description: Lane colour, probability text and the won/lost flags.

LaneRules.description: Lane limits, stored and shown; not enforced.

total.description: Line total excluding VAT, after discount.

MarginPart.description: Cost, revenue and margin of one source.

MarginResource.description: Margin of the lines. Amounts are JSON numbers; transfer-list and hour parts are always 0.

MarkCreditedRequest.description: Mark a pending credit note as paid out.

MessageBody.description: A short message: `ok` after an action, or what went wrong.

Meta.description: Paging details. `total` counts matches across all pages.

from.description: 1-based index of first row on this page; null when the page is empty.

MoveDealRequest.description:
POST /deals/{id}/update-status: the kanban drag. `position` is the 0-based index in the
target column.

from.description: test-send: sender; defaults to the mailbox.

PdfTemplateBody.description: A PDF template. On update the domain stays as stored and fields left out are kept.

columns.description: Item table columns; each names a field of the domain (see available-fields).

oneOf.description: When this template is picked; null clears them.

extra_fields.description: Display flags (`display_signature`, ...) and the specification template id.

PdfTemplateFiles.description: Background and logo files; null when unset or gone.

PersonFields.description: The new person's name, login email and password.

password.description: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.

PipelineResource.description: A deal pipeline (board) with its columns in position order.

total_values.description: Sum of deal values per currency code (number); `[]` when there are none
Sum of deal values per currency code (number); `[]` when there are none

ProfileBody.description: An email profile (create and full update take the same body).

oneOf.description: When this profile is picked; left out keeps them, null clears them.

html.description: Signature HTML; left out keeps it, null clears it.

oneOf.description: Own SMTP server; left out keeps it, null clears it.

ProfileSummary.description: An email profile in a list.

success_connection.description: Always true (a failure is an error reply).

PublicCurrency.description: Currency on the public payment page.

PublicInvoice.description: An invoice as its public payment page shows it.

balance.description: Open is never below 0 and is 0 once paid, cancelled or credited.

company_details.description: The workspace's company profile (no credit limit).

PublicInvoiceItem.description: One line on the public payment page (no costs or stock).

RegisterRequest.description:
POST /v1/register: new account through an invite.
Create an account through an invite link.

Relationships.description: Deal `relationships`; null when the linked row is missing.

SendInviteRequest.description:
POST /v1/workspace/{workspace}/invites. `team_id`: team the invitee joins on accept.
Invite someone by email, optionally straight into a team.

team_id.description: Team the invitee joins on accepting.

SendMessageRequest.description: A message to send. With `send_method` `manual` nothing is sent; without `to` the addressed contact gets it.

address.description: Billing address (address object) a sent document takes.

pdf_template_id.description: The PDF template a sent document renders with; ignored by `/send-message`.

data.description: Every section as an object, or with `?type=` that one section or dotted path (any JSON value; null when unset). Credentials print masked.

SmtpBody.description: A profile's SMTP server as sent.

password.description: Send the mask back to keep the stored password; null or blank clears it.

SmtpView.description: A profile's SMTP server as shown; the password is masked.

password.description: The mask when a password is stored, else null.

custom_status.description: The custom status (`CustomStatusResource`); null once it is deleted.

SummaryResource.description: Document totals. Amounts are JSON numbers (whole amounts print without decimals).

discounts.description: One entry per discounted line: the line on calculate-items, null on stored documents.

total_vats.description: VAT per rate, keyed by the rate as text (e.g. `"21"`).

TeamResource.description: A team: a named group of members sharing a set of permissions.

relationships.description: `[]` when members were not loaded, otherwise `{"users": [...]}`

variables.description: Variables per group (`model`, ...): key -> label; `[]` for a domain without any

TokenResponse.description: A login session: send `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

UnprocessableBody.description: Invalid input (`errors` lists fields), or a business rule refused the request (`message` only)

UpdateCurrencyRequest.description: Changes to a currency. Leave a field out to keep it; send null to clear it.

UpdateDealRequest.description: Changes to a deal. Leave a field out to keep it.

UpdatePipelineRequest.description: Changes to a pipeline. Leave a field out to keep it.

sorting.description: `a-z`, `z-a` or `pos`; blank keeps the stored one.

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: Sections to save, keyed by section name. Each sent section is validated and replaces the stored one; unknown sections and keys are dropped. Send a credential's mask back to keep it.

UpdateStatusRequest.description: Changes to a column. Leave a field out to keep it; `deal_pipeline_id` is required. The custom status never changes.

UploadForm.description: Upload as a multipart form: one file part `upload` (at most 10 MB) plus these text parts; any other part is refused.

public.description: Required; files are always stored private.

UploadRequest.description: Upload as JSON: the file base64-encoded. At most 10 MB once decoded.

public.description: Required; files are always stored private.

UserEmailResource.description:
Laravel UserEmailResource: a user embedded in another resource.
A user shown inside another record (team member, inviter, ...).

color.description: Display color; not stored yet, always null.

ValidationErrorBody.description: Validation failed. `errors` maps each field to its messages.
